🤖 **About Rasa**

Rasa is an open-source conversational AI platform that helps you build contextual AI assistants and chatbots.

**Key Features:**
✅ Natural Language Understanding (NLU) - Understands user intent
✅ Dialogue Management - Manages conversation flow
✅ Open Source - Full control over your data
✅ Enterprise Ready - Scalable and secure
✅ Multi-channel Support - Deploy anywhere

**This Chatbot** is built using Rasa Open Source and demonstrates:
• Intent classification
• Entity extraction
• Custom actions
• Agent escalation

Learn more at https://rasa.com
